messages:
maya: heads up — noticed a parity bug between REST and the python sdk that affects production. REST accepts `max_output_tokens` and `stop_sequences` and honors a 429 + `Retry-After` header. our python client only accepts `max_tokens` and `stop` (legacy names) and silently drops `max_output_tokens`. it also retries on 429 with exponential backoff but ignores `Retry-After`, so we occasionally hammer and cause customer throttles. sample app README also references `temperature` default=1.0 but sdk default is 0.8, which explains a bunch of noisy diffs in evals. repro below.

maya: repro (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite","input":"hello","max_output_tokens":64,"stop_sequences":["\n\n"]}'
```

maya: repro (python):
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(token=os.getenv("TOKEN"))
# sdk currently ignores max_output_tokens
c.generate(model="gpt-lite", input="hello", max_output_tokens=64, stop_sequences=["\n\n"])
```

arjun: :eyes: can reproduce quickly with the sdk. looks like a param rename happened during the model-api refactor and the compatibility shim wasn't added. 429 handling is also different — the sdk's backoff logic predates Retry-After semantics.

sylvia-sdk: thanks @maya and @arjun for the repro. i'll do a small compatibility mapping so SDK will accept both names (`max_output_tokens` -> `max_tokens`) and pass through `stop_sequences`. i'll also update the http client to respect `Retry-After` if present (fall back to current backoff if header missing). will add unit tests and a small integration test against a mock server that responds 429 + Retry-After.

maya: can we get a quick patch for 0.11.x (backport)? we have a customer on Dedicated hitting this today.

devex: we should also update the sample-app README and the quickstart snippets — that mismatch is confusing onboarding. add a changelog note and a migration tip: "if you rely on max_output_tokens, update to SDK >=0.12.1 or use max_tokens as alias."

sylvia-sdk: queued. i'll open two PRs: one for mapping + Retry-After handling (target: main + backport to release/0.11.x) and another to fix docs/sample app. linking once open.

deploy-bot: release-candidate: 0.12.1-rc1 pushed to staging. CI: 117 passed, 3 flaky (unrelated). :rocket:

sdk-bot: note: add regression test that validates header passthrough and parameter aliases. tagging @sylvia-sdk for follow-up.

maya: thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround. if anyone on eng-platform wants to weigh in on the API surface/backport, ping me and i'll loop security/compliance for the Dedicated customer. :thumbsup:
